'''Maccabi Bnei Reineh''' ({{langx|he|מכבי בני ריינה}}; {{langx|ar|مكابي ابناء الرينة}}) is an Israeli football club based in [[Reineh]]. The club played its home matches at the Municipal Stadium. They were promoted to play with [[Bnei Sakhnin F.C.|Bnei Sakhnin]] in the [[Israeli Premier League]] as its second [[Arab-Israeli]] football club for the [[2022–23 Israeli Premier League|2022–23 season]]."}}
